mobileNavigation.interpretation: Cold detail compilation/module loading consumed most of the generic 10-second URL assertion. Production submit calls push and refresh; two successful detail requests were observed, not a failed creation. This is a timing diagnosis, not proof of a production navigation failure.
mobileNavigation.testCorrection: Wait for the actual GET of the new detail resource, assert its status and exact ID, then assert URL/rendering before taking screenshots. No global timeout increase or navigation-source modification.
mobileNavigation.provenance: Root extracted response body and network timing from the failing Playwright traces using read-only ZIP inspection; these observations are recorded separately from final pass results.
